meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先复现某个 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷,在临时工作区写失败的回归测试并实现最小修复,跑通验证后按仓库归属交付:上游 Codex 走 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷则开一个内嵌补丁的 issue。
howto.when: 当你要求修某个 bug、提交 bug 修复、为某个 bug 开 PR,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 Codex CLI 的这个 bug,然后提个 PR
say.note: 会复现、写测试、修好并从 fork 提 PR

say.text: LazyCodex 安装器这块有缺陷,给我开个带补丁的 issue
先复现这个 bug,再写一个会失败的回归测试
say.note: 会真实环境复现并留下命令输出日志

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect in a temp workspace, writes a failing regression test, applies the smallest fix and verifies it, then delivers either a fork PR for upstream openai/codex or a patch-embedded verified-fix issue for LazyCodex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this Codex CLI bug for me and open a PR
say_en.note: Reproduces, tests, fixes, then opens a fork PR

say_en.text: The LazyCodex installer is broken, open an issue with the patch
say_en.note: Creates a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex

say_en.text: Reproduce this bug first, then write a failing regression test
say_en.note: Reproduces on the real surface and saves logs
